# Independent fax decoder fixtures

These four tiny T.4/T.6 streams were generated by Pillow 12.3.0's libtiff
encoder. They are original test patterns, not extracted documents or decoder
code. Recreate with `eval/pdf/scripts/fax_fixtures.py` in the evaluation venv.
The pattern includes empty/full rows, zero initial white runs, shifting edges,
short runs, makeup runs, odd widths and partial output bytes. The Go test
calculates the expected pixels directly without a TIFF dependency.

The decoder's bit-code reference is ITU T.4/T.6; the static run codewords are
transcribed from RFC 804 tables 1–3. Implementation is original Go.
